project.title: Effects of quorum quenching bacterium Delftia sp. JL5 on MBR microbial community
project.description: MBR activated sludge is a complex and dynamic microbial ecology system. The microbial composition and structure determine the function of wastewater treatment. The current research were conducted to determine the impacts of JL5 QQ beads on the microbial community and diversity of lab-scale MBR.
